SELECT r.student_id,
    m.code AS misconception_code,
    m.name AS misconception_name,
    count(*) AS occurrences,
    count(DISTINCT r.item_id) AS distinct_items,
    count(DISTINCT ni.node_id) AS distinct_nodes,
    max(r.created_at) AS last_seen
   FROM (((responses r
     JOIN item_options o ON ((o.id = r.option_id)))
     JOIN misconceptions m ON ((m.id = o.misconception_id)))
     LEFT JOIN node_items ni ON ((ni.item_id = r.item_id)))
  WHERE (r.created_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval))
  GROUP BY r.student_id, m.code, m.name
 HAVING (count(DISTINCT r.item_id) >= 3);

SELECT st.id AS student_id,
    n.id AS node_id,
    n.code,
    n.name,
    u.code AS unit_code,
    n.exam_level,
    COALESCE(vm.effective_status, 'not_started'::text) AS status,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((pre.status <> 'rejected'::text) AND (COALESCE(pm.effective_status, 'not_started'::text) <> 'mastered'::text))) AS pending_prereqs
   FROM (((((((students st
     CROSS JOIN nodes n)
     JOIN units u ON ((u.id = n.unit_id)))
     JOIN areas ar ON ((ar.id = n.area_id)))
     LEFT JOIN v_node_mastery vm ON (((vm.student_id = st.id) AND ((vm.node_code)::text = (n.code)::text))))
     LEFT JOIN node_edges pre ON ((pre.target_id = n.id)))
     LEFT JOIN nodes prn ON ((prn.id = pre.prereq_id)))
     LEFT JOIN v_node_mastery pm ON (((pm.student_id = st.id) AND ((pm.node_code)::text = (prn.code)::text))))
  WHERE ((n.status = 'active'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (student_courses sc
             JOIN courses c ON ((c.id = sc.course_id)))
          WHERE ((sc.student_id = st.id) AND (sc.status = 'active'::text) AND (c.status = 'active'::text) AND (c.subject_id = ar.subject_id) AND ((c.area_id IS NULL) OR (c.area_id = n.area_id)) AND (n.exam_level <= c.exam_level)))))
  GROUP BY st.id, n.id, n.code, n.name, u.code, n.exam_level, vm.effective_status;

SELECT n.code,
    n.name,
    u.code AS unit_code,
    n.exam_level,
    count(DISTINCT ni.item_id) FILTER (WHERE (ni.pool = 'curated'::text)) AS curated_items,
    count(DISTINCT ln.lesson_id) AS lessons,
    count(DISTINCT io.misconception_id) AS covered_misconceptions
   FROM ((((nodes n
     JOIN units u ON ((u.id = n.unit_id)))
     LEFT JOIN node_items ni ON ((ni.node_id = n.id)))
     LEFT JOIN lesson_nodes ln ON ((ln.node_id = n.id)))
     LEFT JOIN item_options io ON (((io.item_id = ni.item_id) AND (io.misconception_id IS NOT NULL))))
  GROUP BY n.code, n.name, u.code, n.exam_level;

SELECT nm.student_id,
    n.code AS node_code,
    n.name AS node_name,
    a.code AS area_code,
    nm.p_correct,
    nm.items_answered,
    nm.items_correct,
    nm.hard_correct,
    nm.status,
        CASE
            WHEN ((nm.status = 'mastered'::text) AND (nm.last_response_at < (now() - ((cfg.validity_days || ' days'::text))::interval))) THEN 'lapsed'::text
            ELSE nm.status
        END AS effective_status,
    nm.last_response_at,
    nm.first_mastered_at,
    nm.config_version,
    nm.computed_at
   FROM (((node_mastery nm
     JOIN nodes n ON ((n.id = nm.node_id)))
     JOIN areas a ON ((a.id = n.area_id)))
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT mastery_config.validity_days
           FROM mastery_config
          WHERE (mastery_config.version = nm.config_version)) cfg);

SELECT r.id,
    r.student_id,
    r.created_at,
    r.context,
    r.session_id,
    r.response_time_ms,
    i.code AS item_code,
    i.author_difficulty,
    o.label AS selected_option,
    COALESCE(o.is_correct, false) AS is_correct,
    (r.option_id IS NULL) AS omitted,
    m.code AS misconception_code,
    m.name AS misconception_name
   FROM (((responses r
     JOIN items i ON ((i.id = r.item_id)))
     LEFT JOIN item_options o ON ((o.id = r.option_id)))
     LEFT JOIN misconceptions m ON ((m.id = o.misconception_id)));
